PS_interpretation: 850->1700 MHz halves DRAM tick duration. Same command timing cycle counts halve corresponding absolute ns delay and change service opportunity. It is a composite frequency/timing sensitivity, not pure bandwidth doubling. Fixed core-clock dram_latency stays unchanged.
mechanism_limits: L2 FIFO-full disappearance is not proof of scheduler/return-queue waiting disappearance.
avg_mrq_latency is an aggregate over differing request populations; not full round trip or per-segment mean.
Host wall time is not simulated GPU execution cycles.
No old2e3 baseline substitution; all matched baselines must be same new9eed build.
No final-cycle predictions from pending observations.

followup_experiment_designs.goal: Separate faster command/data opportunity from reductions in absolute DRAM timing delay.
followup_experiment_designs.design: Keep DRAM=1700MHz; double each elapsed-time DRAM-clock parameter from the 850MHz P0 (RCD/RAS/RP/RC/CL/WL/RRD/WR/CDLR/RTPL, bank-group CCDL where applicable), after auditing derived expressions and constraints. Keep core-clock fixed delays such as dram_latency=100 and L2 ROP unchanged. Keep geometry, mapping, request/return queues, scheduler and input fixed.
followup_experiment_designs.caveat: Do not blindly double nbk, nbkgrp or buswidth. Classify tCCD/CCDL and burst/data-command ratio explicitly: preserving all spacing in ns can also remove the intended throughput increase. State chosen sustained bandwidth and absolute-latency contract; this is not achieved by a single clock edit.
followup_experiment_designs.minimal_scope: One strided kernel/input chosen before seeing new performance, both CH and DH, paired with fresh instrumented baseline only if build changes; exact budget to approve after finished18.

followup_experiment_designs.goal: Test interaction between FIFO capacity and DRAM time-domain speed.
followup_experiment_designs.design: 2x2 of FIFO64/256 and850/1700MHz; existing P0/PQ/PS are three corners. Only after they close strict accepted, add joint corner for matched CH/DH using identical existing binary/config contract.
followup_experiment_designs.interaction_formula: I_cell=C_PQ*C_PS/(C_P0*C_PQPS); multiplicative independent speedups imply1. Compare I_DH/I_CH. No additive speedup assumption.
followup_experiment_designs.minimal_scope: A preregistered sentinel input (ATAX is informative if accepted PQ regression persists); two new model points CH/DH. Broaden only with new approval.

followup_experiment_designs.goal: Distinguish FIFO backpressure removal, scheduler waiting, return congestion, L2 replacement/reissue and DTC completion service.
followup_experiment_designs.design: Instrumentation-only build with counters for queue occupancy-cycle sums/high-water marks/full events; request UID+stage enqueue/dequeue timestamps for L2 miss/FIFO, dram-delay, FRFCFS, bank issue/data ready, return FIFO, DTC completion/retirement; per-kernel sums/counts/histograms. Bounded event sampling keyed by stable UID. Never change allocation/arbitration/admission.
followup_experiment_designs.qualification: CPU tests plus at least a matched reference run verifying exact cycles, instructions, CTA and traffic against uninstrumented binary before causal consumption. Capture source hash, observer overhead, RSS/output limits, cross-kernel draining and request-cohort accounting.
followup_experiment_designs.minimal_scope: One CH/DH sentinel pair at P0 and one discriminating perturbation; exact model-start budget requires new approval.
